description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'cache-tree' functionality within a Git-like version control system. It contains multiple test cases that verify the correctness of cache-tree updates under various Git operations such as commits, resets, checkouts, merges, and tree modifications.

methods.name: cmp_cache_tree
methods.description: Compares the current cache-tree dump against an expected output file after filtering specific lines.

methods.name: generate_expected_cache_tree
methods.description: Recursively generates an expected cache tree listing for a given pathspec and directory, useful for testing cache-tree correctness.

methods.name: test_cache_tree
methods.description: Validates that the current cache-tree matches the expected cache tree stored in a file.

methods.name: test_invalid_cache_tree
methods.description: Checks that an invalid cache-tree state produces the expected error output.

methods.name: test_no_cache_tree
methods.description: Validates that the cache-tree is empty or uninitialized as expected.
